def catmull_rom(points, step_px=2.0):
    """Centripetal-ish smooth interpolation, returning points at <= step_px spacing."""
    p = np.asarray(points, dtype=np.float64)
    out=[]
    # uniform Catmull Rom; duplicate endpoint tangents avoid endpoint overshoot
    for i in range(len(p)-1):

        seg_len=np.linalg.norm(p2-p1)
